svg.title: The installer sets up the tools it needs on a fresh machine — A fresh machine with only sudo and curl adds its missing tool, then stops because the project is not linked to GitLab
svg.text: The installer sets up the tools it needs on a fresh
Scenario: A fresh machine with only sudo and curl adds its missing tool, then stops because the project is

g.text: Given a fresh machine has only sudo and curl, with the installer ready
This machine has sudo and curl but no unzip — the tool the installer will have to add by
itself. The installer files are copied in but not started yet.
When the installer runs on the fresh machine with no one to answer its
The installer starts and prints its title. Nothing on the machine has changed yet.
Then the installer installs the tool it was missing and tries again
task devsecops:init fails because unzip is missing, so the installer adds unzip with sudo
and runs again. The log is checked for the same story.
Then the installer stops and explains how to link the project to GitLab
The installer stops on purpose: the project has no GitLab link yet, so it prints the exact
next step. If this message ever went missing, a new developer would be stuck.

text.tspan: No 'origin' remote configured. Add a GitLab remote, then re-run.
